sections.heading: Transaction Overview and Integration Objectives
sections.body: Following the acquisition of NorthBridge Analytics by HelixPoint Systems effective 1 June 2026, this integration plan outlines the coordinated activities required to ensure uninterrupted operations and accelerated value realization. The primary objectives are to secure Day 1 business continuity, establish accountable workstream ownership, and deliver $18.4M in identified annual run-rate synergies by Q2 FY2027. Integration governance will be led by the IMO under the executive sponsorship of COO Marisol Kent and CFO David Huang.

sections.heading: Day 1 Operational Readiness
sections.body: Day 1 readiness activities focus on customer continuity, payroll and benefits harmonization, IT access provisioning, and regulatory compliance confirmations across 11 operating jurisdictions. A detailed readiness checklist has been completed at 96% with remaining items confined to secondary vendor novations scheduled for closure within 10 business days post-close. All employee communications, including the CEO joint announcement and manager toolkits, are staged for release at 08:00 local time on close date. Critical systems (ERP, CRM, and Service Desk) have been tested for single sign-on interoperability with fallback protocols validated during the 22 April 2026 simulation.

sections.heading: Workstream Governance and Ownership
sections.body: Eight core workstreams have been established: Finance, HR, IT, Commercial, Operations, Legal & Compliance, Supply Chain, and Communications. Each workstream is led by a designated HelixPoint VP paired with a NorthBridge functional lead to ensure balanced representation and knowledge transfer. Weekly milestone reporting will feed into the IMO dashboard, with red-amber-green status tracking and quantified risk exposure. Escalation thresholds are defined at variance levels exceeding 5% of budget or two-week schedule slippage.

sections.heading: Synergy Capture Timeline
sections.body: Total identified synergies are projected at $23.7M gross, with $18.4M net after one-time integration costs of $5.3M. Cost synergies ($14.1M) derive primarily from vendor consolidation, facility rationalization of two overlapping offices in Denver and Leeds, and shared services centralization. Revenue synergies ($4.3M) are expected through cross-selling bundled analytics and cloud migration services to a combined top-150 client base. Approximately 40% of run-rate savings are targeted within the first 100 days, with full realization by Month 15.

sections.heading: Cultural Integration Risks and 100-Day Milestones
sections.body: Cultural assessment surveys conducted in March 2026 indicate differing decision-making tempos and risk tolerance between the two organizations, posing potential friction in product development and client engagement. To mitigate this, cross-company integration squads and leadership alignment workshops will be deployed within the first 30 days. The 100-day tracker includes 27 defined milestones, including ERP chart-of-accounts alignment (Day 45), unified sales compensation plan rollout (Day 60), and consolidated procurement contracts (Day 90). Progress will be reviewed biweekly by the Executive Steering Committee to ensure disciplined execution and early risk intervention.

structure.full_text:
Post-Merger Integration Plan — Day 1 to Day 100 Roadmap
Ref: PMI-8457609 | Date: 04 May 2026 | From: Integration Management Office (IMO)

Section Transaction Overview and Integration Objectives
Following the acquisition of NorthBridge Analytics by HelixPoint Systems effective 1 June 2026, this integration plan outlines the coordinated activities required to ensure uninterrupted operations and accelerated value realization. The primary objectives are to secure Day 1 business continuity, establish accountable workstream ownership, and deliver $18.4M in identified annual run-rate synergies by Q2 FY2027. Integration governance will be led by the IMO under the executive sponsorship of COO Marisol Kent and CFO David Huang.

Section Day 1 Operational Readiness
Day 1 readiness activities focus on customer continuity, payroll and benefits harmonization, IT access provisioning, and regulatory compliance confirmations across 11 operating jurisdictions. A detailed readiness checklist has been completed at 96% with remaining items confined to secondary vendor novations scheduled for closure within 10 business days post-close. All employee communications, including the CEO joint announcement and manager toolkits, are staged for release at 08:00 local time on close date. Critical systems (ERP, CRM, and Service Desk) have been tested for single sign-on interoperability with fallback protocols validated during the 22 April 2026 simulation.

Section Workstream Governance and Ownership
Eight core workstreams have been established: Finance, HR, IT, Commercial, Operations, Legal & Compliance, Supply Chain, and Communications. Each workstream is led by a designated HelixPoint VP paired with a NorthBridge functional lead to ensure balanced representation and knowledge transfer. Weekly milestone reporting will feed into the IMO dashboard, with red-amber-green status tracking and quantified risk exposure. Escalation thresholds are defined at variance levels exceeding 5% of budget or two-week schedule slippage.

Section Synergy Capture Timeline
Total identified synergies are projected at $23.7M gross, with $18.4M net after one-time integration costs of $5.3M. Cost synergies ($14.1M) derive primarily from vendor consolidation, facility rationalization of two overlapping offices in Denver and Leeds, and shared services centralization. Revenue synergies ($4.3M) are expected through cross-selling bundled analytics and cloud migration services to a combined top-150 client base. Approximately 40% of run-rate savings are targeted within the first 100 days, with full realization by Month 15.

Section Cultural Integration Risks and 100-Day Milestones
Cultural assessment surveys conducted in March 2026 indicate differing decision-making tempos and risk tolerance between the two organizations, posing potential friction in product development and client engagement. To mitigate this, cross-company integration squads and leadership alignment workshops will be deployed within the first 30 days. The 100-day tracker includes 27 defined milestones, including ERP chart-of-accounts alignment (Day 45), unified sales compensation plan rollout (Day 60), and consolidated procurement contracts (Day 90). Progress will be reviewed biweekly by the Executive Steering Committee to ensure disciplined execution and early risk intervention.

Confidential — Internal Distribution Only | Page 1 of 1

structure.heading: Synergy Capture Timeline, Cultural Integration Risks, and 100-Day Milestones Tracker
text_content: **Synergy Capture Timeline, Cultural Integration Risks, and 100-Day Milestones Tracker**

The synergy capture timeline targets a run-rate of $60M by 2027-06-30, allocated as $39M (65%) in cost synergies and $21M (35%) in revenue synergies. The Integration Management Office (IMO) will manage phased delivery: Phase 1 (Day 0–Day 180) focuses on $12M of quick-win cost actions and customer cross-sell pilots; Phase 2 (Day 181–Day 540) delivers $24M through procurement consolidation, supply-chain redesign, and pricing optimization; Phase 3 (to 2027-06-30) captures the remaining $24M through transformation programs and new go-to-market initiatives. The CFO and business unit heads will report monthly to the Executive Integration Committee on measured run-rate progression. Governance uses monthly scorecards and variance thresholds.

Cultural integration risks are material and will be monitored across talent retention, decision-making styles, and operating rhythm alignment. The CHRO will track voluntary attrition with a target to keep key-talent loss below 12% in the first 12 months; failure to meet this target poses a projected impact on synergy realization and client continuity. Specific risks include conflicting performance metrics between legacy teams, inconsistent customer experience from integration of Sales and Service, and slow adoption of common systems by IT and Operations. Mitigations include a 90-day cultural alignment program led by HR and the CEO, targeted retention bonuses, local leadership workshops, and pulse surveys.

The 100-day milestones tracker contains 12 milestones with the first checkpoint on Day 30 (30 days post-close); cadence is weekly reviews and monthly executive updates. Primary owners are the Integration Lead, CIO, CHRO, General Counsel, and Sales Lead. Milestones include: 1. Day 30: Governance and communication plan finalized (Integration Lead); 2. Day 45: Key-system accounts migrated (CIO); 3. Day 60: Cost quick wins validated ($12M) (CFO); 4. Day 75: Sales cross-sell pilots launched (Head of Sales); 5. Day 90: HR integration executed and retention actions implemented (CHRO); 6–12: subsequent operational, compliance, and customer milestones through Day 100. Progress tracked in the IMO dashboard.

structure.heading: Day 1 Readiness and Workstream Ownership (Operating Model and Decision Rights)
text_content: **Day 1 Readiness and Workstream Ownership (Operating Model and Decision Rights)**

Day 1 is 2026-07-01 and represents the operative go-live for combined entity systems, policies, and customer-facing processes. The Integration Management Office (IMO) is led by Maria Chen and will execute the initial 72-hour stabilization plan, with a contingency reserve of 10% of integration budget allocated to immediate remediation. As of 2026-06-25, 94% of critical Day 1 tasks were verified in the IMO dashboard; remaining items target closure by 2026-06-29. Key Day 1 actions include payroll cutover, network segmentation, customer communication release, and legal entity mapping; each action has an assigned owner and SLA. Executive steering will convene within 24 hours.

The integration program is organized into six workstreams: Finance, HR, IT, Operations, Sales, and Legal, each with defined Day 1 owners and pre-approved decision rights. Owner assignments: Finance — CFO Office (owner: David Patel); HR — Head of People (owner: Anika Rao); IT — CIO (owner: Luis Ortega); Operations — COO (owner: Priya Singh); Sales — CSO (owner: Mark Bennett); Legal — General Counsel (owner: Elena Rossi). Workstream Day 1 deliverables are doc.ed with metrics: Finance (100% payroll readiness), HR (100% benefits enrollment transition), IT (98% system cutover), Operations (95% facility access), Sales (95% CRM migration), Legal (entity filings 100%).

The operating model formalizes decision rights, escalation paths, and approval thresholds to ensure Day 1 continuity. A RACI-based decision rights matrix was finalized on 2026-06-20 and assigns primary authority to functional workstream owners while reserving 12 escalation items for executive review. Approximately 80% of routine Day 1 decisions are pre-authorized; 95% of vendor contract approvals below $250k have delegated authority to workstream leads. Escalation SLAs require initial response within 2 hours and resolution or executive escalation within 24 hours. Governance cadence: daily IMO stand-ups at 07:30 (starting 2026-07-01), weekly Steering Committee on Wednesdays, and biweekly sponsor reviews. Escalations are logged.
